annotations.title: Get the fix prompt for a site

description: Return a ready-to-run task list for a coding agent that fixes every failed agent-readiness and AI-search check on the site (for example adding llms.txt, unblocking AI crawlers, adding structured data), biggest first, with how to verify each change. Same scan as check_site.

domain.description: The site to check, like example.com

job.description: What agents should do on the site: recommend (answer questions about it), buy, signup, api (get an API key) or personal (a person's own site: who they are, their work, how to reach them). Leave out to detect it.

name: get_fixes
title: Get the fix prompt for a site
